reviewContext.userProblem: With ocr.vendor = claude-code, stria ocr stored the reply "I don't see an image attached to your message..." as ocrStatus = done. GatewayPromptRunner sends page images as ACP image blocks, but agent-gateway c7f2697 forwards GatewayExecuteParams.images only for API vendors; CLI vendors (GatewayVendor.isCLI: claude-code, codex, cursor) drop them silently, so OCR and ask lose their page images.
requiredOutcomes: For CLI vendors, every image prompt part is rendered at the same index as a text part naming the absolute PNG path with an instruction to open and read the file; the session cwd stays paths.cache.
API vendors (openai, anthropic, gemini, openrouter, cursor-api) receive the same parts as before, including image blocks.
The rendering decision lives in the pure function GatewayPromptParts.rendered(_:for:), unit-tested offline.

A gateway OCR reply that is empty after cleaning, or that says no image was received (English and Japanese phrases, reply at most 600 characters), throws ServiceError.failed with a fixed reason, so the page is recorded failed and --retry-failed re-runs it.
New offline tests cover CLI vs API rendering, the reply check and the coordinator failed path.
swift build, swift test, swiftlint (0 violations) and scripts/cli-smoke.sh (SMOKE OK) pass; every Swift file stays under 1000 lines.

designDecisionsAndRationale: CLI vendors get PNG paths as prompt text because GatewayExecution.executeCLI never reads images; a manual claude-code run confirmed the agent reads an image path given in the prompt with cwd = paths.cache (design-agent-integration.md#vendor-image-capability, agent-gateway-c7f2697.md#image-inputs-and-process-errors).
The vendor split uses GatewayVendor.isCLI from AgentGateway, so the rule follows the gateway's own classification.
Image parts are replaced at the same index with a fixed two-line template, one wording for OCR and ask, so prompt order is preserved.
The reply check lives in GatewayOCRService, not OCRCoordinator, so pdf-text-layer blank pages stay done.
Rejection reasons are fixed strings and never quote the reply, so run records do not contain OCR text; the service returns the raw text and the coordinator still cleans it.
The phrase match is limited to replies of at most 600 characters and excludes a bare 'no image' phrase to avoid false positives on real page text.
intentionalTradeoffs: Blank pages OCR'd by a gateway vendor become failed (empty reply) and are retried on --retry-failed; tracked as pending in design-docs/user-qa/ocr-empty-reply.md.
The no-image detection is a phrase heuristic (19 English, 7 Japanese phrases) and can miss other wordings.
CLI agents need file-read permission inside paths.cache; this is not enforced by stria.
AgentRunRecord.imageCount keeps counting image parts even when they are sent as paths.
supportedEdgeCases: Curly apostrophe (U+2019) in the reply, as in the issue repro.
Case-insensitive English phrases and Japanese phrases.
Whitespace-only and fenced-empty replies count as empty.
Replies longer than 600 characters that contain a phrase are accepted as text.
Ask with several context page images keeps each path text at its original image index.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Other no-image wordings or languages beyond the listed phrases.
CLI agents that refuse or cannot read files in the working directory.
cursor-api image support (still rejected by preflight as unavailable).
